AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food Frying Frying? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food Frying Frying.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Food Nutrients and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food Frying Frying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming Practices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
